items.title: Seven HIGH write-ups carried stale or wrong figures; corrected against the official source (fixed 2026-10-22)
items.detail: A line-by-line re-read of all 33 published HIGH pieces against the official pages they cite found stale or wrong figures in seven of them; all are corrected and re-sourced. (1) HBL-15 said Szeged had conceded 124 goals in four EHF Champions League games and GOG 132. The official EHF Group D table publishes Szeged 139:136 and GOG 145:139, and the same table plus the EHF round-5 preview show GOG won the reverse fixture 36:34, which the piece had omitted; the write-up was rewritten to those figures and now states the counter-evidence. (2) DRT-11 called Krzysztof Ratajski the 19th seed; the PDC's own field-and-draw release lists him as the third seed against 30th seed Dave Chisnall. (3) MTR-01's headline called Max Verstappen a three-time Austin winner; Formula 1's own race statistics list four Circuit of the Americas wins (2021, 2022, 2023, 2025). (4) TEN-31 gave Alexander Bublik as world No. 22; the official ATP list of 19 October 2026 has him at No. 19. (5) TEN-32 gave Damir Dzumhur as world No. 103; the same list has him at No. 83. (6) TEN-33 said Flavio Cobolli carried 1,650 ATP ranking points; the official list shows 3,640.
